description: Flat, rounded, 2-tone shading with one soft dark outline on every filled shape. Chosen in Phase 2 (see svg/_style-test/b-*.svg).
highlight: Lighter tint of the base colour, no outline, on the upper-left of the shape.
flag-colours: Flags use their official colours, not this palette.

themed.note: The engine swaps accent, accent-2 and the greys for the video's theme colours; draw themed items with only these.

m3-roles.description: How the engine maps SVG colours to Material 3 roles generated from the video's seed colour (Material Color Utilities). Exact hex match, case-insensitive.
m3-roles.applies-to: themed items fully; keep items only map the outline ink (#2E2A3B) when the video asks for a themed outline
